what_it_does: This paper measures and models the carbon emissions of supercomputers. It introduces EasyC, a tool that estimates the carbon footprint of high-performance computing (HPC) systems using only publicly available data from the Top500 supercomputer list. The tool separates emissions into two categories: operational carbon (energy used while running) and embodied carbon (emissions from manufacturing hardware). It provides carbon accounting for 391 systems and projects how total HPC carbon emissions will evolve through 2030.
